D48.name: 1h 48-bar channel breakout
D48.long: Current completed H1 close > max(high of exactly prior 48 completed H1 bars), with latest completed H4 EMA20 > EMA60.
D48.short: Current completed H1 close < min(low of exactly prior 48 completed H1 bars), with latest completed H4 EMA20 < EMA60.

B20.name: 1h Bollinger re-entry in low directional strength
B20.bands: 20 H1 closes, rolling population standard deviation ddof=0, mean +/- 2 standard deviations; each bar's own band is causal.
B20.regime: Latest completed H4 ADX14 < 20; finite positive band width required.
B20.long: Immediately previous H1 A.close < A.lower_band, and current H1 B.lower_band < B.close < B.upper_band.
B20.short: Immediately previous H1 A.close > A.upper_band, and current H1 B.lower_band < B.close < B.upper_band.
B20.stop_additional_anchor: Include A.low for long or A.high for short.

S24.name: 1h failed 24-bar range break
S24.long: Current low < min(low of exactly prior 24 completed H1 bars), current close > that prior minimum, and current close > current open.
S24.short: Current high > max(high of exactly prior 24 completed H1 bars), current close < that prior maximum, and current close < current open.

EC20_60.name: 1h EMA20/EMA60 crossover with 4h alignment
EC20_60.long: Previous H1 EMA20 <= EMA60 and current H1 EMA20 > EMA60; latest complete H4 EMA20 > EMA60.
EC20_60.short: Previous H1 EMA20 >= EMA60 and current H1 EMA20 < EMA60; latest complete H4 EMA20 < EMA60.
EC20_60.cross_only: Sustained alignment without a new crossover is not another signal.

shared_entry_semantics.hourly_aggregation: Exactly four continuous complete UTC 15m bars, decimal OHLCV aggregation; no partial hours.
shared_entry_semantics.higher_timeframe: Latest complete UTC H4 whose close_time <= H1 decision close; never the current unfinished H4.
shared_entry_semantics.long_stop: min(current H1 low, current H1 close - 1.5 * H1 ATR14); B20 also includes preceding H1 low.
shared_entry_semantics.short_stop: max(current H1 high, current H1 close + 1.5 * H1 ATR14); B20 also includes preceding H1 high.
shared_entry_semantics.invalid_or_missing_feature: Record wait/rejection; never fill with future values or zero.
shared_entry_semantics.event: One symbol/candidate/direction/decision-close identity; known_at=H1.close_time+1; modeled execution signal_time=known_at+900000ms.
shared_entry_semantics.execution_scope: Historical availability and one-full-15m-bar latency assumptions, not an assertion of actual live fills. Delay scenario is additional.

execution_limits.same_shared_account_engine: research_portfolio.replay_portfolio plus position_manager lifecycle; no new execution or PnL engine.
execution_limits.nominal_cap: Existing engine limits total nominal exposure to one times equity.
execution_limits.exit: Existing structure_atr generally exits fully at 1R. Maximum holding limit is 96 x 15m = 24 hours, not 96 H1 bars. Same-bar stop first; adverse gaps use actual open; tail positions are marked without artificial liquidation.
execution_limits.attribution_limit: This compares fixed entry-timeframe/structure-stop expressions under a common exit, not isolated entry accuracy; failure does not reject all slow trend strategies.
execution_limits.costs: Hypothetical per-fill notional fee/slippage assumptions, not verified user account rates; signed real funding cash flows remain separate.

baseline: Recalculate original ProjectSignalEngine with both directions on the same BTC/ETH 15m inputs, account, dates and costs. Do not reuse the prior nine-trade long-only baseline. Idle collateral reference is zero modeled return.
account_continuity: One continuous account per variant/scenario. Recent-segment return uses marked equity at 2026-06-20 and at final time; do not reset capital, delete boundary positions or relabel the segment OOS.

continuation_screen.origin: Proposed research prioritization screen; no real-account contract or promotion authority.
all_required: both symbols full-period base marked PnL contribution > 0
continuation_screen.interpretation: Passing only permits a separately frozen next validation; it does not establish statistical or out-of-sample profitability.
continuation_screen.ranking: Show all candidates; inspect the screen first, then joint net return/win rate/payoff/risk. Never rank by win rate alone.

uncertainty.method: Paired two-week moving-block bootstrap of full continuous weekly account returns using the existing descriptive helper.
uncertainty.scope: Descriptive intervals, not a corrected significance or promotion test. BTC/ETH, adjacent trades, D48/EC and past adaptive searches are dependent.

trial_registry.budget_rule: 4 candidates plus original baseline, each base/double-cost/delay; no result-driven extra candidate or threshold sweep.
trial_registry.previous_attempts: TPR1, V1, C1/C2, exit variants and other historical research were already inspected; total adaptive past attempts are not fully enumerated.
trial_registry.exposure: All historical data are previously or potentially exposed. The candidates are fixed before this batch's PnL, but this is not a fresh holdout or a restored blind test.
trial_registry.stop: After this fixed batch, retain every result. Do not modify failed candidates in this data batch to manufacture a winner.

reference_scope: These historical studies motivate exploring mechanisms; they do not validate these H1 thresholds, candidates, costs or expected returns.
